//: TODO(design): lineages and generations (GAME_DESIGN.md §12), written by Claude for M6; change freely. names: what a hydra can be called, picked at random; a name that comes again in the same lineage gets a number (Morwenna II), and the lineage is named after its first hydra. takeAncestorName: the chance that an heiress is named after one of her ancestresses (so numbers come up). inheritedShare: the share of her mother's mutations an heiress inherits, picked at random and rounded up. ancestorVoice.chance: how often an ancestress speaks through sleep when a new generation hatches (dialogues.json, trigger ancestorInSleep). epitaphs: the lines of the Book of Lineages, after the hydra's name. byEnemy: by the kind of enemy that killed her (enemies.json types; when a group of several kinds kills her, one of them is picked); any: when the killer has no lines of its own; ended: the last hydra of a lineage the player ended by starting a new one. {turns}: how many turns she lived; {biome}: where she fell.

manAtArms: Slain by a man-at-arms collecting the tithe. He gave her a receipt.
Cut down by a patrol that had been told she was a rumour.
Killed by soldiers of the Order, who took turns, as is proper.
headhunter: Taken one head at a time by a headhunter, who was paid by the head.
Slain by a headhunter. He kept a receipt for every neck.
Outnumbered, briefly, by a man with an axe.
torchbearer: Burnt shut, neck by neck, by a lay brother with a torch and a great deal of patience.
Cauterised by the Order. The smell was entered into the record.
Slain by a torchbearer who had never been allowed to hold the torch before.
censerPriest: Smoked out under the open sky by a Censer Priest, who forgave her afterwards.
Slain in a cloud of incense. The Order calls it a blessing; the heads called it several other things.
brazierBearer: Dried out by a Brazier Bearer, one basket of coals at a time.
Slain on ground the Order had dried for the purpose. It was entered as land reclaimed.

any: Slain by the Order of the Eternal Flame. A report was filed in triplicate.
Fell in the {biome} after {turns} turns. The heads still disagree about whose fault it was.
Lived {turns} turns. The Order will hold a small mass about it.
ended: Left the swamp to another line. Nobody filed anything.
The last of her line, by choice. Old Mother Toad kept her name anyway.
